```sql
WITH literacy_changes AS (
  SELECT
    State,
    District,
    "Survey Round",
    "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS literacy_percentage
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE "Survey Round" IN ('NFHS-4', 'NFHS-5')
    AND State IN ('Bihar', 'Jharkhand', 'Odisha')
    AND District IN ('Bhojpur', 'Cuttack', 'Dumka', 'Ganjam', 'Gaya', 'Giridih', 'Gumla', 'Hazaribagh', 'Kalahandi', 'Kishanganj', 'Koraput', 'Madhubani', 'Mayurbhanj', 'Nalanda', 'Palamu', 'Purnia', 'Ranchi', 'Rayagada', 'Rohtas', 'Saran')
)
SELECT
  State,
  District,
  nfhs4.literacy_percentage AS nfhs4_literacy,
  nfhs5.literacy_percentage AS nfhs5_literacy,
  (nfhs5.literacy_percentage - nfhs4.literacy_percentage) AS percentage_point_change
FROM literacy_changes nfhs4
JOIN literacy_changes nfhs5
  ON nfhs4.State = nfhs5.State
  AND nfhs4.District = nfhs5.District
  AND nfhs4."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
  AND nfhs5."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
WHERE (nfhs5.literacy_percentage - nfhs4.literacy_percentage) < 0
ORDER BY percentage_point_change;
```
